title: A retained prerequisite: queue identity to release verification handoff
question: When does restoring a retained prerequisite fix a failed task, and when must that transfer be rejected?
evidence_status: Synthetic queue fixture plus real pre-existing local release code exercised in isolated copies; no production outage is claimed.

protocol.scope: One transferable prerequisite-recovery mechanism; three new target instances and three pre-existing queue fixtures. No L_P, numerical-core change or comparative-effectiveness claim.
protocol.decision_rule: Choose the feasible listed action with the smallest declared intervention credit, then alphabetical ID. Credits order options in this experiment; measured execution and representation effort are reported separately.
protocol.holdout_policy: Both fixed selectors and the case protocol are frozen before target executions. A digest of all target-instance predictions is calculated and locally persisted before any target intervention runs; this is not external preregistration. Opaque case IDs are not selector inputs. Action IDs identify outputs and break exact cost ties, but are not used as diagnostic clues. Missing/stale receipt families were explored during discovery: these are held-out executions, not previously unseen problem families, blinded human reasoning, or independent test-set generalization.

mapping.source: Required payload identity w2 must be completed, in addition to w1 and w3.
mapping.target: A receipt with passed=true and the exact current input_fingerprints must exist at verification_checks.json before package.py can pass its receipt gate.
mapping.preserved: Exact job identities; exact file names, byte counts and SHA-256 values. Jobs are not mapped to abstract throughput totals.

mapping.source: w2 is in backup_payload_ids but absent from pending_fifo_payload_ids and completed_payload_ids.
mapping.target: A real prior verification receipt is retained outside the active observatory folder while its required active path is missing.
mapping.preserved: The target backup is an experimental handoff condition, not a claim that package.py implements a backup service. It is copied byte-for-byte from an actual successful verification.

mapping.source: Replay appends available missing backups before tick 1, preserving payload identities.
mapping.target: Copy the retained receipt into the required path; do not change its passed field or fingerprints.
mapping.preserved: Receipt content is source evidence; no verdict flag is inserted into the method's case facts.

mapping.source: An absent required identity cannot be replaced by a different job or created by a higher service rate.
mapping.target: A correctly named file with the wrong input snapshot cannot substitute for current verification; a stale assembled HTML also defeats a full re-verification attempt.
mapping.preserved: Availability, revision identity and independent completion constraints are separate predicates.

mapping.source: Queue rate is measured in jobs/tick and interacts with a three-tick deadline.
mapping.target: The package code has no service-rate setting. Three concurrent calls test repeated processing without prerequisite repair, not a quantitative queue-throughput law.
mapping.preserved: No conversion between queue time, call concurrency, execution seconds and credits is introduced.

protocol.falsifier: The strongest direct falsifier is a case whose exact current compatible receipt is available, all independently specified package constraints hold, and byte-identical restoration nevertheless fails to produce a valid current archive. A prediction mismatch is reported, never relabeled as a success. Stale receipts and stale assembly are explicit boundaries, not that strongest falsifier.

analogy_levels.descriptive_resemblance: Both tasks can look stalled while repeated processing is available. That appearance alone does not justify an intervention.
analogy_levels.shared_structure: A named required prerequisite is absent from the active set; an identity-compatible retained token can enter the active set without altering its content, subject to other constraints.
analogy_levels.intervention_transfer: Transfer is supported only where the actual target executable accepts the restored compatible receipt and produces a verified archive. Replaying a stale receipt and re-verifying stale assembly must be rejected.

limitations: This is a fixed-rule mechanism pilot. The role representation performs inspectable typed constraint propagation, but neither method is an open-ended reasoner and this is not a CANON superiority benchmark.
The target is pre-existing software acceptance code from the same local project, frozen before this pilot, not an independent external operational dataset.

The receipt gate trusts passed and exact input fingerprints; it does not authenticate receipt origin or independently rerun every test. The experiment uses genuine generated receipts, but cannot generalize acceptance to a cryptographic verification guarantee.
Case families were selected after code inspection. Target instance execution is held out from selector execution; the family design is not blind and the sample is too small for efficacy estimates.

The alternate verification action assumes the same executable, test and data inputs as the actually checked seed, with only a documented README change allowed. Arbitrary revisions and runtime/environment failures require a richer model.
No build repair is offered in the stale-assembly case. Rejection means none of the three listed actions succeeds, not that the project cannot ever be repaired.
The original accepted evidence, standalone examples, numerical core, L_P reconciliation and data acquisition are untouched.

decision_commit.scope: All three target prediction digests locally persisted before all target interventions; not external preregistration. Boundary families were known during design.

task.objective: Complete every required payload by the original deadline.

facts.job_service_requirement: Every payload requires one job completion; jobs have equal unit size.
facts.service_timing: At the end of each integer tick, complete up to the active service rate of FIFO jobs. An action at tick 0 takes effect before tick 1.
facts.backup_rule: Replay appends each listed available backup not already pending/completed at tick 0. There are no other copies.

roleGraph.scope: Equal unit jobs; FIFO order retained in active-token order; no invented arrivals.

role.claim: Only the supplied finite action effects and constraints are evaluated.

Displayed persistence frames and replay receipt share exact source-linked samples
Source drill-down links only bundled local lake paths and explicit music/model files
Selected contribution and disclosure state restore and recompute from the saved native selection

checks.name: Zero contributions give one closed baseline shell above the reference plane
Native values retain sign, units and identity; display compression is explicit and bounded
Both encodings use the same two signed contributions under shared calibration
Missing channels, invalid scales and unsupported cameras are rejected
Camera, viewport and labels affect presentation only; picks bind exact native values

result.scope: Closed-mesh topology, finite display geometry, source-value binding, shared calibration and camera invariance. Browser inspection is separately required.

results.name: Selected source copies and the separate template match their recorded exact-byte hashes
Every selected entity and lookup retains every native field, empty value, label and ordering
Every relationship and source mapping resolves to its exact retained native record and field
Coverage distinguishes explicit aggregates, missing metadata and native unclassified labels
Only capture timestamps are exposed; catalogue classifications are never represented as a sampled signal
SCM invalid-query and historical-fingerprint issues remain distinct from zero results and measurements
MM lake remains a template-only entry, without attributing any demonstration music to it

result.scope: Exact copied bytes, complete native field retention, recorded relationship references, coverage and metadata/measurement boundaries. External originals absent on another machine remain unavailable, not verified.
Pure model, exact source selection, bounded discrepancy and session contracts; not browser or audio acceptance.

results.name: Default state is complete and independently copied
Fixed reference matches known sinusoid extrema and does not change under candidate edits
Candidate analytical velocity agrees with an independent finite difference
Align changes observation time/value, preserving candidate recipe and derivative semantics
Transport looping does not invent source support; missing overlap is counted
Exact generated match has zero pointwise discrepancy over the declared half-open window
PCM selection is nearest stored sample, with index, quantization and exact source reference
Music Tune is unapplied; B alignment maps both channels and metrics use native sampling
Native-rate PCM discrepancy matches hand-computed shifted/gained sample pairs
PCM missingness and invalid sampling are explicit; lake records do not become waveforms
Deep validation rejects extra fields, coercion, impossible bounds, unsupported stretching and excess alternatives
Whole saved interaction state and generated alternatives restore without triggering playback or audio
Contribution selection is source-appropriate and disclosure state is strict
Restore rejects altered transformation/source/rendering receipts and never trusts a supplied capture

assembly.newline_policy: UTF-8 without BOM; template/code CRLF and CR become LF; binary HTML output; raw evidence bytes and fingerprints unchanged.
assembly.model_fingerprint_policy: SHA-256 of model.js decoded as UTF-8, CRLF/CR normalized to LF, then UTF-8 encoded; no other rewriting.
assembly.scope: Exact executable bytes and binary output; all code/data/audio embedded. Accepted-baseline and evidence hyperlinks open separately on user action.

music.scope: Retained PCM header/data/hash and supplied annotation bounds, order, coverage and generator fingerprint. Audibility and browser transport are separate.

accepted_baseline.scope: Read-only comparison to the retained accepted release manifest and custody record.

content.scope: Observatory contracts, exact offline assembly, supplied stereo music and immutable accepted baseline. Browser interaction/audio and visual usability are separately evidenced.

effort.timing_policy: Per-case timings are actual wall times for shared inspection, role construction and both selectors. Native baseline consumes the identical native fact packet. Subprocess logs include actual verification/execution times.
effort.construction_time: Manual authoring time was not independently instrumented. Source/function/line counts expose construction size; no lower-effort claim is made.

limitations: This is a fixed-rule mechanism pilot. The role representation performs inspectable typed constraint propagation, but neither method is an open-ended reasoner and this is not a CANON superiority benchmark.
The target is pre-existing software acceptance code from the same local project, frozen before this pilot, not an independent external operational dataset.

The receipt gate trusts passed and exact input fingerprints; it does not authenticate receipt origin or independently rerun every test. The experiment uses genuine generated receipts, but cannot generalize acceptance to a cryptographic verification guarantee.
Case families were selected after code inspection. Target instance execution is held out from selector execution; the family design is not blind and the sample is too small for efficacy estimates.

The alternate verification action assumes the same executable, test and data inputs as the actually checked seed, with only a documented README change allowed. Arbitrary revisions and runtime/environment failures require a richer model.
No build repair is offered in the stale-assembly case. Rejection means none of the three listed actions succeeds, not that the project cannot ever be repaired.
The original accepted evidence, standalone examples, numerical core, L_P reconciliation and data acquisition are untouched.
